issue: NAI selection img2img target resolution does not follow selection changes

before.reproduction: Choose Selection as the NAI img2img source, note the automatically calculated target resolution, then replace or resize the Krita selection after the document wrapper has been refreshed by the host.
before.expected: The current selection bounds trigger a new automatic target resolution and the width and height controls update without reselecting Selection.
before.actual: The target resolution remains calculated from the previous selection. The existing automated test manually called the original document wrapper poll method and did not cover host wrapper replacement.

adjacent_working_case: Selecting Selection initially calculates a target, changing the selection on the original document wrapper updates it, and concrete-layer img2img targets must not react to selection changes.
hypothesis: ControlLayer connects directly to the document wrapper that existed at construction, while DocumentModel may replace that wrapper when Krita refreshes its Python document object; the selection signal is never rebound to the current wrapper.
disproof: The hypothesis is false if a control connected only to the original wrapper still updates when selection_bounds_changed is emitted exclusively by a replacement wrapper.
